disputed.finding: Stocktake timing: Art. 14(2) says 'in 2023 and every five years thereafter unless otherwise decided by the CMA'. The draft drops the qualifier, and as of Nov 2026 the first GST concluded at COP28 (Dec 2023) with the next in 2028; the draft ignores this.
disputed.objection: The notes do not provide the full Article 14(2) qualifier or any post-2023 update status, so this claim is not settled by the notes.

disputed.finding: The draft says the stocktake ‘happens on the same broad timetable as NDC submission.’ The notes support both being on five-year cycles, but the draft overstates the tightness of that coordination; Article 14 only says the stocktake is every five years starting in 2023 and Article 4 says NDCs are every five years.
disputed.objection: The draft only says 'same broad timetable', which the shared five-year cycles support, so the overstatement the finding alleges is minor and no passage settles it.
